subject: a compact owl in a translucent folded helmet
pose: head turned slightly with one wing raised near the collar
art_direction: 矮胖猫头鹰戴半透明短头盔，紫粉面光和青色眼圈营造夜行角色，头盔顶部像折起的小彗尾。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a squat owl wearing a short translucent helmet whose top folds backward into a small comet-like fin. The owl face remains natural, with broad eye discs, a tiny beak, and an alert quietly witty gaze. Use muted magenta face light, cyan helmet edges, and warm cream feather planes. One wing rises close to the collar as a small greeting, keeping the pose compact. Render the helmet thickness, a few feather layers, and subtle reflected color without covering the eyes with glare. The background is deep indigo and empty. Center the head and upper body within the square, with all helmet folds inside the circular crop and no symbols or text.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
